credits.title: Cows Come Home
credits.overview: Chaotic and broken Tabby Acres moves back to her small town and tries to put her life back together with the help of her best friend and the world of competitive cow showing.

credits.title: Love in a Hopeless Place
credits.overview: Modern dating sucks. Deidre is looking for love but she also has the luxury of feeding off them when they don't work out.

credits.title: Lunar Sway
credits.overview: Cliff is struggling with his love life in a desert town when he unexpectedly connects with his estranged birth mother. After learning of his mom’s string of secrets, Cliff is led on a wild misadventure while also spending time with his love interest, Stew, a mysterious dentist.

credits.title: Shook
credits.overview: After a run-in with his estranged father, aspiring writer Ashish or "Ash" learns a secret that will force him to balance family, love and success while navigating the divide between the exciting city life he wants and his suburban reality.

credits.title: Mother Father Sister Brother Frank
credits.overview: The Jennings family couldn't be more suburban but when Uncle Frank crashes their weekly Sunday dinner, murder turns up on the menu.

credits.title: Plant Daddy
credits.overview: After rescuing an abandoned potted plant, Phil spirals into an absurd plant obsession to avoid visiting his father on his deathbed.

credits.title: The Love Club: Tara’s Tune
credits.overview: Tara has always considered herself to be a free spirit. Moreover, the talented singer doesn’t seek love. Instead, she has her friends in The Love Club.

credits.title: Save the Date
credits.overview: A young gay millennial is forced to confront his complex feelings about his (sort of) ex when he finds himself invited to celebrate his ex’s engagement.

credits.title: The Forgetting Device
credits.overview: The Forgetting Device (2022)  A man begins to suspect that something strange and sinister is responsible for his recent memory loss.

credits.title: Pigs
credits.overview: A short film following one woman's fantasy during a catering shift from hell.
